# Build CSV content from songs_info_by_id and write to ~/backups/spotify_library.csv

# Ensure songs_info_by_id exists
print('songs_info_by_id count:', len(songs_info_by_id))

# Deduplicate by (Title, Artists)
unique_rows = {}
for sid, (title, artists_str) in songs_info_by_id.items():
    key = (title, artists_str)
    if key not in unique_rows:
        unique_rows[key] = sid

rows = [(title, artists) for (title, artists) in unique_rows.keys()]
print('unique (Title, Artists) rows:', len(rows))
print('sample rows:', rows[:5])

# Prepare CSV with header Title, Artists

def csv_cell(val: str):
    if val is None:
        val = ''
    val = str(val)
    # Quote only if contains delimiter comma-space or quotes or newlines
    if (' , ' in val) or (', ' in val) or ('"' in val) or ('\n' in val) or ('\r' in val):
        # escape quotes
        val = val.replace('"', '""')
        return '"' + val + '"'
    return val

header = 'Title, Artists'
lines = [header]
for title, artists in rows:
    lines.append(f"{csv_cell(title)}, {csv_cell(artists)}")
content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('CSV preview:\n', '\n'.join(lines[:6]))

# File system login and write
file_pwd = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
email = 'sab-brown@gmail.com'
file_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username=email, password=file_pwd)['access_token']

backup_dir = '~/backups'
file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'

# ensure directory exists
exists_resp = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=file_access_token)
print('backup_dir exists:', exists_resp)
if not exists_resp.get('exists', False):
    print('creating directory...')
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=file_access_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

# create/overwrite file
if apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_access_token)['exists']:
    print('file exists; will overwrite')
else:
    print('file does not exist; will create')

resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_access_token, content=content, overwrite=True)
print('create_file response:', resp)

# read back
read = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_access_token)
print('read back keys:', read.keys())
print('read back content length:', len(read.get('content','')))

# verify header and line count
content_read = read.get('content','')
first_line = content_read.splitlines()[0] if content_read.splitlines() else ''
line_count = len(content_read.splitlines())
print('first_line:', first_line)
print('line_count:', line_count, 'expected:', len(rows)+1)
